请务必使用我的工作流程上传您的图像。我想看看你的结果:)

克莱因模型注意：我已经修改了克莱因模型的工作流程，但尚未将其更新到我的页面。我也可能不会上传它，因为工作流程页面中还没有人上传图像。不过，如果有人主动将他们的结果/图像上传到我的工作流程页面，我可能会分发更新的克莱因工作流程。如果有人想知道/注意到我当前的克莱因图像与发布的工作流程的结果相比的质量差异，我只是这么说。它仍然是一个很棒的工作流程。

Z-IMAGE：这是我通常使用的精简/最小版本。这比“完整”版本更快、更简单。尽管如此，它仍然能产生很棒的图像。我建议使用我使用的模型和 loras，可以在我的帖子中找到。另外，如果您使用细节滑块 lora，请将其从 1.00 调低至 0.50，以使其更亮，同时仍保持良好的细节。我上传的工作流程旨在成为您可以构建的基础。它拥有您获得优质图像所需的大部分工具，而且不会太复杂。

o.en:
Be sure to upload your image with my workflow. i want to see your results :)

Klein model Notice: i have since revised my workflow for klein model, but have not yet updated it to my page. I may not upload it either since there hasn't been people uploading images in the workflow page. Though i may distribute the updated klein workflow if someone is actively uploading their results/images to my workflow page. Im just saying this if anyone is wondering/noticing a quality difference between my current Klein images compared to the results of the posted workflow. its still a great workflow to start off.

Z-IMAGE: This is a lite/minimal version from the one i usually use. This is faster and simpler than the "full" version. Nonetheless, it still produces great images. I suggest using the model and loras i used which can be found in my post. Also, if you are using detail slider lora, turn it down from 1.00 to 0.50 to make it brighter while still maintaining good detail. the workflow i uploaded is meant to be a foundation that you can build upon. it has most of the tools that you need to get good images already without being too complicated.
